def transform(grid):
    # Recolor each of the two input colors according to its role: the rarer
    # color becomes 7, the more common color becomes 0.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    colors = sorted(counts, key=lambda c: (counts[c], c))
    fg = colors[0]
    bg = colors[-1]
    return [[7 if v == fg else 0 for v in row] for row in grid]
PY
